drums.tags: Industrial rock and noise rock track at 115 BPM in the key of E minor. The arrangement features a heavily distorted, overdriven electric bass playing a repetitive, syncopated riff that emphasizes the root and minor third. The drum kit consists of a dry, punchy kick drum and a metallic, industrial-sounding snare with a short decay. A second electric guitar provides high-pitched, dissonant feedback and scratchy, non-melodic textures. The track utilizes a raw, lo-fi production style with minimal reverb and a compressed dynamic range. The rhythmic structure is built on a steady 4/4 pulse with occasional rhythmic displacements in the bass line.

bass.tags: Funk-rock fusion featuring a prominent, syncopated electric bass guitar as the lead melodic and rhythmic voice. The bass utilizes a mix of fingerstyle plucking, percussive slaps, and pops, often doubling the kick drum patterns. A clean electric guitar provides rhythmic stabs and muted scratches on the off-beats. The drum kit maintains a steady backbeat with a crisp snare and tight hi-hat work, occasionally incorporating ghost notes. The arrangement is centered around a repetitive, groovy bass riff that undergoes slight variations in intensity and phrasing. The production is dry with minimal reverb, emphasizing the percussive attack of the strings. Key: E minor. Tempo: 105 BPM.
